title: chabraea glacialis
intro: Chabraea glacialis, commonly known as Snow leopard, is a plant species in the family Gentianaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chabraea glacialis include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, making it useful for treating pain, inflammation, and immune-related disorders. Bioactive constituents present in Chabraea glacialis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
